item.title: Turnitin vs AIDetector.cx: 2026 Comparison
item.description: A comparison of institutional and public-facing content-integrity workflows, documented capabilities, access models, and AI-detection limitations. It does not claim a verified head-to-head accuracy winner.

item.title: ChatGPT Detector Comparison: GPT-4 vs GPT-5.5
item.description: Compare how top AI detectors handle raw and edited ChatGPT outputs from GPT-4, GPT-4o, and GPT-5.5 across academic, SEO, and marketing use cases.
